name: vwap_deviation_momentum
research_hypothesis: Volume-expanded price strength relative to the minute average price has short-term continuation.
mechanism_explanation: A price premium over average traded price may reflect aggressive buying. Scaling by current volume relative to its recent level gives more weight to volume-supported moves. The mechanism can fail around reversals, stale or extreme prices, thin volume, and structural gaps.
python_code:
import pandas as pd


def vwap_deviation_momentum(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Measure volume-supported price deviation from minute average price."""
    close = pd.to_numeric(df["close"], errors="coerce")
    average = pd.to_numeric(df["average"], errors="coerce")
    volume = pd.to_numeric(df["volume"], errors="coerce")
    relative_volume = volume / volume.rolling(20, min_periods=1).mean()
    factor = (close / average - 1.0) * relative_volume
    factor.name = "vwap_deviation_momentum"
    return factor.astype(float)
